settings.logs.title: Machine log
settings.logs.body: What happens on this machine: each Daoris process writes a line an event, kept thirty days, to improve Daoris from. Nobody's words are in it — no message, prompt or answer — and it never leaves this machine. `daoris-driver logs` reads the same lines at a terminal.
settings.logs.notOpened: This window cannot open a folder. The log is in {{folder}}.
settings.logs.none: Nothing in the log for these filters.
settings.logs.skipped: {{shown}} line could not be read and was skipped.
settings.logs.skipped_other: {{shown}} lines could not be read and were skipped.
